note: SRA on a 315-acre no-wake lake 2.5 mi east of Hickman (within 25 mi of Lincoln). The camping pads are in one gravel loop above the lake's southeast cove, with a marshy strip between them and the water; the non-pad basic sites are along the park roads to the north. Primitive restrooms; swimming beach. Pay at the iron ranger. Lake levels were low after a 2022 aquatic-habitat renovation plus drought. --Claude
summary: Booking confirmed first-come only (no reservation mark on NGPC's grid; not on ReserveAmerica). Phone matches the grid. Pin is ~800 m NE of the pad loop, at the north basic-site road: re-pin. Not waterfront stands, with a lakeview lead for the pad loop above the cove. Fees/hookups/sites left (no readable agency page; outdoornebraska.gov blocked).
flags: PIN ~800 m off: stored 40.63093,-96.57335 is at the turnaround of the northern road where the grass (non-pad) sites are. The gravel pad loop (about 28 herringbone pads, presumably the electric sites) is at ~40.62445,-96.57825 on NAIP, matching the OSM caravan_site node 40.6244465,-96.5781312. Suggest re-pin to 40.62445,-96.57825.

WATERFRONT not waterfront stands (lead, no change): on NAIP (700 m frame) the westmost pads of the pad loop are ~70-100 m from the open water of the lake's southeast cove, across a green marsh/grass strip with scattered trees, and the loop's own road runs along that side. Not on-water. The pads sit on the slope above the cove and may see the water across the marsh, so lakeview is possible, but with no official campsite photos readable (outdoornebraska.gov blocked) nothing earns the upgrade. The northern basic sites (stored pin) are 500 m+ from the lake in woods. The NIR water mask was unusable here (trees read as water), so distances are imagery estimates.
